title: Strata-Sword: A Hierarchical Safety Evaluation towards LLMs based on Reasoning Complexity of Jailbreak Instructions
reasoning: While the paper includes 'ethical issues' as one of the risk categories evaluated in its safety benchmark, the primary focus is on jailbreak attacks and safety alignment (e.g., preventing the generation of harmful or illegal content). It does not systematically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith traditions, or formal systems of ethics.
